feeds.title: Its a Wonderful Movie - Your Guide to Family and Christmas Movies on TV
feeds.description: At Its a Wonderful Movie you will find news, fashion, and updates on original family movies on TV plus Christmas movies on the Hallmark Channel, Hallmark Movies and Mysteries, UP, Lifetime, INSP, ION, TCM, and More. You'll receive updates, TV schedules, pictures, and more on movie premieres on TV - all year long.

feeds.title: 18 Cinema Lane » Christmas
feeds.description: Sally Silverscreen is the writer of 18 Cinema Lane. For as long as she can remember, she has loved movies and the movie-going experience. Talking about movies is something she holds dear to her heart and it brings her so much joy to be able to talk about what she loves on this blog. She likes watching a variety of movies and watching each one with an open mind. She has a dedicated Christmas movie section for Christmas lovers.

feeds.title: Lolly Christmas » Christmas Movies
feeds.description: Lolly Christmas was created in 2011 to share the love of the holiday season with others as Lolly did with her children growing up. Find a comprehensive list of holiday programming all year long with Lolly's Holiday TV Guide!

feeds.title: Ruthless Reviews » Christmas Movie Reviews
feeds.description: Ruthless Reviews was founded in 2003 or maybe 2004. Though originally focused on pet-friendly bed and breakfasts and regional art and craft fairs, Ruthless quickly shifted its coverage to movies, TV, music, politics, and miscellaneous. The site accidentally obtained popularity by focusing on 1980s action movies and Scandinavian heavy metal. It is also becoming famous for the ABC rants and contrarian Christmas Reviews.

feeds.title: PopCult Blog » Christmas
feeds.description: PopCult Reviews is the place to take a deep dive into media and culture from a Left perspective. This isn't content coming from a lofty, complicated, academic point of view but accessible reviews and analysis. They're here to celebrate the good stuff and put a critical lens on the media that has saturated culture. Check out their blog and learn more about Christmas posts, and articles written by Seth Harris.

feeds.title: Hallmark Holidaze: Movie Reviews from The Heart or Something
feeds.description: Hallmark Holidaze: Movie Reviews from The Heart or Something is written by Laura. This blog was born over text messages, wine, and a deep and abiding love of bad Hallmark Christmas Movies.

feeds.title: Due South » Christmas Movies
feeds.description: Due South is a blog about the best of small-town, cozy living. The blog contains recipes, road trips, parenting, knitting, canning, woodwork, books, and movies. One section of the blog focuses on Christmas movies for those who celebrate the holiday by watching movies.

feeds.title: Trash or Treasure » Christmas Movies
feeds.description: Trash or Treasure is a movie review blog. Here the author reviews the content other sites leave behind. He includes movies, documentaries, TV, and comics as well in his reviews. One can find Christmas movie reviews too.

feeds.title: The Film Magazine » Christmas
feeds.description: The Film Magazine, Ltd. is an independently owned business based in the United Kingdom. As a collective of film scholars and aficionados, they are intent on making a safe space for film fans, critics, and academics to engage with thought-provoking and insightful articles on cinema big and small, and have throughout their history embraced analytical thought and critical insight across their output on both thefilmagazine.com and their social media platforms.

feeds.title: Sandrafirstruleoffilmclubharris » Christmas Films
feeds.description: Sandrafirstruleoffilmclubharris is the place where Sandra will be posting reviews of all the films that catch her attention and float her boat. The emphasis will probably be on horror because that's what she is into, but you can still expect to find just about any film here, as long as she finds it interesting, quirky, original, or even downright terrible because that can be great fun too…!

feeds.title: Nick The Movie Critic » Christmas
feeds.description: Nick is a huge movie fan. He has been active since 2016. He thought he would start this blog to give true and accurate reviews of movies. Here you will find movie reviews, cinema, films, video games, anime, blogs, movies, reviews, film reviews, and more.

feeds.title: Deck The Hallmark Blog
feeds.description: Sarah loves creating recipes and decorating. She loves Christmas and Christmas movies and she has rolled all that love into one giant blog of joy and fun here at the Deck The Hallmark Blog. She is also a wife and mom of two little boys, and that keeps her super busy every day.

feeds.title: Countdown Until Christmas
feeds.description: Countdown Until Christmas gives the latest on new Hallmark and Lifetime Christmas movie premieres, holiday TV specials, and schedules. Readers will find A to Z listing of all Christmas movies ever made, movies by decade, original movies, and much more.

feeds.title: Christmas TV History
feeds.description: Christmas TV History is owned and founded by Joanna Wilson. She is committed to contributing to the scholarly study of television and leading the conversation on the history of Christmas on TV. She draws upon her academic background in film history and philosophy to create insightful commentary on television, movies, and popular culture. Visit the blog where a discussion of popular culture and television through the lens of Christmas-themed episodes, specials, and movies.
